label: UC dawn
_focal: The painting's horizon point as fractions of the image (x across, y down). Set y to where the horizon sits in Gemini's paintings. cover: the point of Gemini's cover painting that crops keep in view (the campus is at 0.78 across).
_sun: Where the sun rises in the portrait paintings (between the towers). Computer screens built from the portrait paintings place it away from the text column.
_towerTop: Where the tops of the two towers sit in the portrait paintings, as a fraction of the height (measured on the sunrise painting; all four share the composition). Phones and tablets move the painting down when the fullest text block would come closer to them than 0.058 of the screen's height.
_windows: Windows screens use the landscape paintings mirrored left to right (the campus on the left, the text column on the calm right), cropped to 16:9 from the top so the horizon and the clock corner stay clear. Mac screens use them as they are.
_files: Which phase images exist, per orientation (npm run art:prepare keeps this up to date). The browser requests only these. Computer screens use the landscape paintings once all four exist; until then (and for uploaded pictures) they extend the portrait paintings sideways.
_source: Paintings by Google Gemini, prepared by scripts/art_prepare.py (2x Lanczos upscale, sky debanding; originals never modified). Which files are Gemini's and which are still stand-ins is recorded in data/gemini.json (art.*).
